title: Tokenization & Embeddings
description: Master tokenization, subword tokenizers, embeddings, and vector representations of text.

data.text: Tokenization converts text to tokens. Subword tokenizers like BPE and WordPiece balance vocabulary size and coverage. Embeddings convert tokens to dense vector representations.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Tokenization breaks text into model-readable units
Subword tokenizers handle unknown words via subword pieces
Embeddings represent tokens as dense vectors
Similar tokens have similar embeddings in vector space
Token count affects cost and context window usage
data.takeaway: Understanding tokenization and embeddings is crucial for cost optimization and effective prompting. Count tokens before sending to APIs to manage costs.
